name: ICAO Machine Readable Zone
description: Draft MIP mapping for parsing and validating the check digits of ICAO machine-readable zones. MRZ check digits detect transcription errors; they do not provide cryptographic authenticity, issuer trust, or holder binding.
specification_reference: ICAO Doc 9303 Part 3 and the applicable document-format part (Parts 4-8)

required_claims.name: doc_type
required_claims.description: Document type code from the MRZ

required_claims.name: issuing_country
required_claims.description: Three-letter issuing State or organization code

required_claims.name: birth_date
required_claims.description: Date of birth encoded in the MRZ

required_claims.name: sex
required_claims.description: Sex marker encoded in the MRZ

required_claims.name: expiry_date
required_claims.description: Document expiry date encoded in the MRZ
